title: Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2006, Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2006, Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the role-playing category, Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
